units.source_text: 下午，将平日的对局室迁到旧馆六号室。

en.t: In the afternoon, the usual game room was moved to Room Six in the old building.

units.source_text: 中午过后，天阴沉下来，鸟儿不停啁啾啼啭。

en.t: After noon, the sky grew overcast, and the birds kept chirping and singing without pause.
A lamp was lit over the go board.

units.source_text: 一百瓦的灯泡太亮，用了六十瓦的。

en.t: A hundred-watt bulb was too bright, so a sixty-watt one was used.

units.source_text: 在棋盘上隐约投下了棋子的阴影。

en.t: It cast the faint shadows of the stones onto the board.

units.source_text: 这是最后一天，旅馆主人别具匠心地装饰了一番，

en.t: Since this was the final day, the innkeeper had decorated the room with particular care,

units.source_text: 壁龛的画轴也换上了川端玉章的对幅山水画，

en.t: and the scrolls in the alcove had been changed to a pair of landscape paintings by Kawabata Gyokusho,

units.source_text: 摆设了骑着大象的佛像，

en.t: with a Buddhist image riding an elephant set out on display,

units.source_text: 旁边摆着一盘盛满胡萝卜、黄瓜、西红柿、香菇、鸭儿芹的供品。

en.t: and beside it stood a plate of offerings piled with carrots, cucumbers, tomatoes, shiitake mushrooms, and mitsuba.
